app.Enthält den Datenstand unmittelbar vor d: Contains the data state immediately before the last restore — a new restore replaces it automatically.
app.Backups liegen nur lokal auf diesem Gerä: Backups are stored locally on this device only and are lost if the device fails — the app does not back up externally. For extra protection, download the files below and store them e.g. on a NAS.
app.Zeichnet einmalig den nächsten Schreibvo: Records the next write once (without API token), then switches off automatically. Contains sensitive entity IDs and raw values and is deleted after 60 minutes at the latest.
app.Aufgezeichnet um {capture_captured_at} &: Recorded at {capture_captured_at} · {capture_event_count} event(s) · automatic deletion in {capture_expires_in_minutes} minute(s)
app.Protokolliert 15 Minuten lang Werte und: Logs values and ingest results of one entity for 15 minutes, then switches off automatically. The raw values stay in the log according to the Supervisor retention.
app.Mindest-Schweregrad für App-Logeinträge: Minimum severity for app log entries
app.Wirkt sofort, Zugangsdaten werden immer: Takes effect immediately; credentials are always masked
app.Keine markierten Datensätze für diese En: No marked records found for this entity.
app.Entfernt zur Löschung markierte Datensät: Automatically removes records marked for deletion once their mark has reached the minimum age — newer marks are left untouched and can be restored via “Undo”.
app.Läuft im Hintergrund, wie die automatisc: Runs in the background, like automatic compaction
app.Wie lange eine Löschmarkierung unangetas: How long a deletion mark is left untouched before it is physically removed
app.Entfernt markierte Datensätze endgültig: Permanently removes marked records and frees up storage. Rollups are recalculated automatically.
This preview does not change any data.
app.{count} Löschmarkierung ohne passende Ro: {count} deletion mark without a matching raw data row — will not be removed.
app.{count} Löschmarkierungen ohne passende: {count} deletion marks without a matching raw data row — will not be removed.

app.Aktuell sind keine Datensätze zur Löschu: No records are currently marked for deletion.
app.Löscht Werte nach Ablauf ihrer Aufbewahr: Deletes values after their retention period has expired — permanently. “Unlimited” entities are excluded.
app.Letzte 30 Tage endgültig gelöscht: Permanently deleted in the last 30 days
app.Läuft im Hintergrund, verpasste Läufe we: Runs in the background; missed runs are made up.
app.Löscht abgelaufene Werte automatisch nac: Deletes expired values automatically on a schedule
app.Tag der Woche für den automatischen Lauf: Day of the week for the automatic run
app.Tageszeit für den automatischen Lauf: Time of day for the automatic run
app.Bestand und Fälligkeit nach Aufbewahrung: Inventory and due status by retention period
app.Vergleicht Index mit den gespeicherten R: Compares the index with the stored raw data. The check only reads; repair only corrects derived values.
The preview has not changed anything yet.
app.✓ Index stimmt mit den gespeicherten Roh: ✓ The index matches the stored raw data.
app.{errors} Entität konnte nicht vollständi: {errors} entity could not be checked completely.
app.{errors} Entitäten konnten nicht vollstä: {errors} entities could not be checked completely.
app.Prüft, ob die Rohdaten im Hot Buffer sel: Checks whether the raw data in the hot buffer is itself still readable — independent of the index comparison above, but run together with it. Damage almost always results from an unclean restart (power failure, hard kill) and cannot be repaired — the affected values are irretrievably lost.
app.Wechselnder Praxis-Tipp im Meldungs-Cent: Rotating practical tip in the notice center
app.API-Token für die Integration &mdash; zu: API token for the integration — copy it for setup (Settings → Devices & services → Zeitarchiv).
app.Globale Konfiguration &mdash; unabhängig: Global configuration — independent of individual entities.
app.Aussehen der App sowie Standardwerte für: Set the look of the app and defaults for chart options.
app.Standardwerte für neu erkannte Entitäten: Defaults for newly detected entities. Existing ones remain unchanged. Can be changed individually in the entity configuration.
app.Stummgeschaltete Meldungen aus dem Meldu: Muted notices from the notice center (bell icon above) — only recommendations can be muted, not errors.
app.Nur der heutige Tipp lässt sich ausblend: Only today’s tip can be hidden — tomorrow it will be a different one anyway.
app.Werkzeuge zur Fehlersuche und Laufzeitin: Troubleshooting tools and runtime information of the app.
app.Betriebs- und Konfigurationsdaten, keine: Operating and configuration data, no tokens, measurements or entity IDs.
app.Was der Wartungsplaner alle 30 Sekunden: What the maintenance scheduler checks every 30 seconds, with last run and status.
app.Wie oft ein Zugriff wegen Überlastung ni: How often an access did not get its turn in time because of overload — occasional occurrences are normal (e.g. during a backup or index optimization); only a pattern would be notable.
app.Home-Assistant-App zur langfristigen Arc: Home Assistant app for long-term archiving and analysis of entity time series — space-saving Parquet+zstd storage, charts, tables, import/export and safe data maintenance.
app.Zeitarchiv &middot; lokal erzeugt, keine: Zeitarchiv · generated locally, no cloud transfer
app.Noch keine Gruppen — Namen eingeben, um: No groups yet — enter a name to create one.
app.Wie euer Strom fließt — von der Erzeugun: How your electricity flows — from generation to consumer.
app.Grundeinstellungen für das Energiedashbo: Basic settings for the energy dashboard.
app.Beschriftung des Sammelknotens in der Sa: Label of the collecting node in the middle of the Sankey diagram.
app.Schwellenwert für die Auffälligkeiten-Ma: Threshold for the anomaly marker. “Off” disables the check.
app.Energiefluss ist immer sichtbar — alle a: Energy flow is always visible — all other tiles can be hidden individually here.
app.Farblegende unter dem Energiefluss, inkl: Color legend below the energy flow, including the blended tone for the share from own generation.
app.Verbraucher mit zugewiesener Gruppe (sie: Consumers with an assigned group (see below) then appear as one combined row instead of individually — devices without a group remain listed individually.
Grid import is the only required role. Everything else stays empty until suitable sensors are assigned.
app.Zähler „aus dem Netz bezogene Energie\": Counter “energy drawn from the grid” (kWh, increasing).
app.Zähler „ins Netz eingespeiste Energie\": Counter “energy fed into the grid” (kWh, increasing).
app.Beliebig viele Erzeuger, z. B. Dach-PV u: Any number of generators, e.g. rooftop PV and an additional balcony power plant.
app.Zähler „von diesem Erzeuger produzierte: Counter “energy produced by this generator” (kWh, increasing).
app.Beliebig viele Batteriespeicher, z. B. e: Any number of battery storage units, e.g. a home battery and a separate balcony power plant with its own storage. Values across several storage units are summed (energy) or capacity-weighted averaged (state of charge).
app.Zähler „aus dem Speicher entnommene Ener: Counter “energy taken from the storage” (kWh, increasing).
app.Zähler „in den Speicher geladene Energie: Counter “energy charged into the storage” (kWh, increasing).
app.Nutzbare Gesamtkapazität, nur nötig für: Usable total capacity, only needed for the kWh display. An entity takes precedence; Wh is converted automatically.
app.Beliebig viele einzeln erfasste Verbrauc: Any number of individually recorded consumers, e.g. wallbox or heat pump. Via a group (e.g. “Mobility”) several of them can be combined into one node in the energy flow.
app.Zähler „von diesem Verbraucher verbrauch: Counter “energy consumed by this consumer” (kWh, increasing).
app.Optional — fasst mehrere Verbraucher im: Optional — combines several consumers in the energy flow into one node.
app.Der Rest (Netzbezug + Erzeuger − Verbrau: The remainder (grid import + generators − consumers − feed-in − storage charging) appears automatically as “base load” — no separate sensor needed.
app.Optional — Preis-Sensoren für Netzbezug: Optional — price sensors for grid import and feed-in. Calculated per bucket, so it also works with variable/dynamic tariffs. Without a suitable price entity, a fixed price in cents per kWh can be entered instead — if an entity is chosen, it takes precedence.
app.Preis in Cent/kWh, wird mit dem bezogene: Price in cents/kWh, multiplied by the imported electricity to give the grid import costs.
app.Vergütung in Cent/kWh, wird mit der eing: Remuneration in cents/kWh, multiplied by the fed-in energy to give the feed-in revenue.
app.Nur für Anlagen mit einer echten Zahlung: Only for systems with an actual payment on self-consumed electricity (e.g. CHP bonus) — for most systems this field stays empty. Remuneration in cents/kWh, multiplied by self-consumption (generation minus feed-in) and added to the feed-in revenue in the balance.
app.Optional — Prognose-Sensoren, z. B. von: Optional — forecast sensors, e.g. from Forecast.Solar or Solcast.
kWh still expected today (e.g. Forecast.Solar “Estimated energy production – remaining day”).
app.kWh, die für morgen insgesamt erwartet w: kWh expected in total for tomorrow.
app.Optional — CO2-Intensität des bezogenen: Optional — CO2 intensity of the imported grid electricity (g/kWh), e.g. via an Electricity Maps / CO2 Signal entity. PV and storage count as emission-free and need no factor of their own. Without a suitable entity, a fixed value can be entered instead — if an entity is chosen, it takes precedence.
app.g CO2/kWh &mdash; ergibt mit dem Netzbez: g CO2/kWh — gives the emissions when multiplied by grid import and the avoided CO2 when multiplied by PV self-consumption.
app.Fasst mehrere Verbraucher im Energieflus: Combines several consumers in the energy flow into one lane, e.g. “Mobility”.
app.Noch nicht eingerichtet. Ordnet Netzbezu: Not set up yet. Assign grid import, generators, storage and consumers to an entity each — the Sankey flow is then created automatically.
app.Energiebilanz-Prüfung, Datenqualitäts-Ch: Energy balance check, data quality checks and unusually high consumption for the selected period.
app.Kein Verbraucher/keine Gruppe deutlich ü: No consumer/group significantly above the usual average.
app.CO2-Ausstoß durch Netzbezug und vermiede: CO2 emissions from grid import and CO2 avoided through PV self-consumption, for the selected period.
app.Vermiedenes CO2 = PV-Eigenverbrauch × CO: Avoided CO2 = PV self-consumption × CO2 factor of grid import, i.e. the CO2 the grid import would otherwise have caused. Balance = emissions − avoided.
app.Netzbezug-Kosten, Einspeisung-Erlös und: Grid import costs, feed-in revenue and balance for the selected period.
app.Einsparung = PV-Eigenverbrauch × Netzbez: Savings = PV self-consumption × grid import price, purely calculated, not included in the balance. Balance = grid import costs − feed-in revenue.
app.Entladung ÷ Ladung je Monat (letzte drei: Discharge ÷ charge per month (last three years) — shows whether the storage efficiency changes over time (e.g. due to battery aging).
app.Noch nicht genug Historie für einen Tren: Not enough history for a trend yet — needs at least one full month with charge/discharge activity.
app.Anteil des Verbrauchs, der NICHT aus dem: Share of consumption that did NOT come from the grid, per month (last three years).
app.Noch nicht genug Historie für einen Tren: Not enough history for a trend yet.
app.Anteil der Erzeugung, der selbst verbrau: Share of generation that was self-consumed (not fed in), per month (last three years).
app.Ø Ladezustand je Monat (letzte drei Jahr: Avg. state of charge per month (last three years).
app.Gesamtverbrauch im gewählten Zeitraum: e: Total consumption in the selected period: recorded consumers together with the base load (devices not measured individually, calculated from the balance).
app.Netzenergiebilanz = Netzbezug − Einspeis: Net grid energy balance = grid import − feed-in. Positive: more imported than fed in (net import). Negative: more fed in than imported (net feed-in).
